text:
dina: Heads-up: published a tiny community release — redwood-plugin-showcase v0.1.0. It's a curated set of 4 short plugins (chat-ui, embeddings-inspector, webhook-middleware, local-metrics) intended as reference patterns for maintainers. Link + quick run note below.

release-bot: Release: redwood-inference/redwood-plugin-showcase v0.1.0
https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-plugin-showcase/releases/tag/v0.1.0
Changelog: add 4 example plugins, per-plugin READMEs, example CI, and CONTRIBUTING guide for community submissions.

dina: Run the embeddings-inspector locally: 
```bash
git clone https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-plugin-showcase.git
cd redwood-plugin-showcase/embeddings-inspector
npm ci
npm start
# visit http://localhost:4000 and follow README for example data
```

peter: License? want to keep it Apache-2.0 so plugins are easy to reuse.

dina: Yep Apache-2.0 and CONTRIBUTING.md explains how to propose plugins.

leah: Security note: all plugins use placeholder env vars and the CI has a secret-scan action. Maintainers, please don't merge changes that add keys to repos.

dina: Good call @leah  added a short MAINTAINER_CHECKLIST in the repo.

devrel-bot: Community Showcase livestream + Q&A: Fri 3pm PT. RSVP here: https://forms.gle/example-showcase (tick if you want to demo).

omar: Two-line blurb for the newsletter please?

dina: "redwood-plugin-showcase v0.1  four reference plugins and contribution patterns to help maintainers ship integrations faster. Join the Showcase livestream Fri 3pm PT for demos and Q&A."

dina: Thanks all  if you plan to demo, add your demo notes to the RSVP form so we can schedule slots. :sparkles:
